description: Don rework: fewer examinations, bounded success openings, denser ordinary attacks. Each arm: Normal/Hell x melee/ranged x circle/reactive x 3 seeds.

conditions.player: Stage-II base profile, no items/affixes/dash, 100000 diagnostic HP, real 130-HP hit protection.
conditions.full_fights: Full real encounters; six stage-tier weapons, base profile, no items/affixes, armor retained. Open arena, 280-unit start. Diagnostic 100000 HP reserve with reference max HP used for normal hit protection. No dash. Real-time SFX callbacks suppressed to keep their throttling out of global combat RNG. Objective knowledge explicit; King beam uses a dedicated route pilot in every policy. Seeker does not dodge outside that puzzle; circle only orbits; reactive reads visible warnings with regular-profile delay. Gross damage is not a human survival rate. Threatened fraction is the regular pilot's standing risk >= 1 sampled at 10 Hz; a bot-specific proxy, not an objective difficulty score.
conditions.attack_only_control: No weapons; health progression/trials disabled; boss phase 2 for exactly 30 s. Unique bodyguard stays alive. Base build metadata only supplies stats/positioning.
conditions.normal_combat_analysis: Damage outside recorded trial intervals / duration outside trial routines. Includes ordinary health transitions and the continuous bodyguard. Boundaries resolved to 1/60 s.
conditions.caution: Gross damage and bot risk are diagnostics, not human survival or fun. Short stationary-phase controls can change favorably for a particular route when attack timing changes.
